newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca to expand drug ingredient capability.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca to expand drug ingredient capability.

text.p: Bioscience specialist Zeneca Group Plc said on Wednesday that it was to expand and upgrade its facilities for producing the key ingredients for drugs.
A Zeneca spokeswoman said the company was taking advantage of a growing trend by drug and agrochemical companies to turn to outside suppliers for key ingredients, known as intermediates.

Financial details of the expansion of the Zeneca Lifescience Molecules (LSM) plant at Huddersfield, northern England, were not disclosed. But the company said the project was part of a 14 million stg investment programme.
The enlarged plant is due to come on stream in March 1997.
